```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Purpose

This is a cumulative RStudio workflow. Run chunks from top to bottom using the green **Run Current Chunk** button or:

```text
Ctrl + Alt + C
```

Each object is calculated once and reused later:

```text
rgb → gli → otsu_threshold → vegetation_mask → vegetation_gli → plot_level_traits
```

There are no interactive raster maps, no Leaflet map, no Mapview output, and no automatically executed analytical chunks. All image and overlay results use standard R plots.

# 1. Load packages and data

```{r load-data, eval=FALSE}
library(terra)
library(sf)

terraOptions(progress = 0)

orthomosaic_path <- "data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif"
plots_path <- "data/plot_boundaries.geojson"

if (!file.exists(orthomosaic_path)) {
  stop("Missing data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif")
}

if (!file.exists(plots_path)) {
  stop("Missing data/plot_boundaries.geojson")
}

rgb <- terra::rast(orthomosaic_path)
plots <- terra::vect(plots_path)

if (terra::nlyr(rgb) < 3) {
  stop("The RGB orthomosaic must contain at least three bands.")
}

# Use the first three layers. Expected order: Red, Green, Blue.
rgb <- rgb[[1:3]]
names(rgb) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

plot_id_candidates <- c("plot_id", "Plot_ID", "plot", "Plot", "id", "ID")
plot_id_matches <- plot_id_candidates[plot_id_candidates %in% names(plots)]

if (length(plot_id_matches) == 0) {
  plots$plot_id <- paste0("Plot_", seq_len(nrow(plots)))
  plot_id_field <- "plot_id"
} else {
  plot_id_field <- plot_id_matches[[1]]
}

cat("RGB bands:", paste(names(rgb), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of plots:", nrow(plots), "\n")
```

# 2. Inspect the RGB orthomosaic

```{r inspect-rgb, eval=FALSE}
print(rgb)

cat("Bands:", terra::nlyr(rgb), "\n")
cat("Rows and columns:", terra::nrow(rgb), "x", terra::ncol(rgb), "\n")
cat("Resolution:", paste(terra::res(rgb), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat(
  "Extent:",
  paste(
    c(terra::xmin(rgb), terra::xmax(rgb), terra::ymin(rgb), terra::ymax(rgb)),
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat("CRS:", terra::crs(rgb), "\n")
```

# 3. Compare the RGB bands

```{r compare-bands, eval=FALSE}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

plot(
  rgb[["Red"]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "Reds"),
  main = "Red Band"
)

plot(
  rgb[["Green"]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "Greens"),
  main = "Green Band"
)

plot(
  rgb[["Blue"]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "Blues"),
  main = "Blue Band"
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# 4. Display the RGB composite

```{r rgb-composite, eval=FALSE}
terra::plotRGB(
  rgb,
  r = 1,
  g = 2,
  b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "RGB True-Color Orthomosaic"
)
```

# 5. Calculate GLI once

The Green Leaf Index is:

\[
GLI = \frac{2Green - Red - Blue}{2Green + Red + Blue}
\]

```{r calculate-gli, eval=FALSE}
red <- rgb[["Red"]]
green <- rgb[["Green"]]
blue <- rgb[["Blue"]]

gli_denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue

gli <- terra::ifel(
  gli_denominator == 0,
  NA,
  (2 * green - red - blue) / gli_denominator
)

names(gli) <- "GLI"

plot(
  gli,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "RdYlGn"),
  main = "Green Leaf Index"
)

terra::global(
  gli,
  c("min", "mean", "max"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

# 6. Calculate the Otsu threshold once

```{r otsu-function, eval=FALSE}
calculate_otsu_threshold <- function(raster, sample_size = 100000, bins = 256) {
  sample_n <- min(sample_size, terra::ncell(raster))

  sampled <- terra::spatSample(
    raster,
    size = sample_n,
    method = "regular",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    values = TRUE
  )

  pixel_values <- as.numeric(sampled[, 1])
  pixel_values <- pixel_values[is.finite(pixel_values)]

  if (length(pixel_values) < 2) {
    stop("Not enough valid GLI pixels for Otsu thresholding.")
  }

  histogram <- hist(
    pixel_values,
    breaks = bins,
    plot = FALSE
  )

  probabilities <- histogram$counts / sum(histogram$counts)
  cumulative_probability <- cumsum(probabilities)
  cumulative_mean <- cumsum(probabilities * histogram$mids)
  total_mean <- sum(probabilities * histogram$mids)

  between_class_variance <-
    (total_mean * cumulative_probability - cumulative_mean)^2 /
    (cumulative_probability * (1 - cumulative_probability))

  between_class_variance[!is.finite(between_class_variance)] <- NA_real_

  histogram$mids[which.max(between_class_variance)]
}
```

```{r calculate-otsu, eval=FALSE}
otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)

cat("Otsu GLI threshold:", round(otsu_threshold, 4), "\n")

gli_values <- terra::values(gli, mat = FALSE)
gli_values <- gli_values[is.finite(gli_values)]

hist(
  gli_values,
  breaks = 80,
  col = "grey80",
  border = "white",
  main = "GLI Distribution and Otsu Threshold",
  xlab = "GLI"
)

abline(
  v = otsu_threshold,
  col = "red",
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 2
)
```

# 7. Create the vegetation mask once

```{r vegetation-mask, eval=FALSE}
vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(
  gli > otsu_threshold,
  1,
  0
)

names(vegetation_mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"

plot(
  vegetation_mask,
  col = c("grey85", "forestgreen"),
  main = "Binary Vegetation Mask"
)
```

# 8. Mask the RGB orthomosaic and GLI layer

```{r mask-rgb-gli, eval=FALSE}
vegetation_only_mask <- terra::ifel(
  vegetation_mask == 1,
  1,
  NA
)

vegetation_rgb <- rgb * vegetation_only_mask

vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(
  vegetation_mask == 1,
  gli,
  NA
)

names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"

terra::plotRGB(
  vegetation_rgb,
  r = 1,
  g = 2,
  b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "Vegetation-Only RGB"
)

plot(
  vegetation_gli,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"),
  main = "Vegetation-Only GLI"
)
```

# 9. Align plot polygons

```{r align-plots, eval=FALSE}
raster_crs <- terra::crs(vegetation_gli, proj = TRUE)
plot_crs <- terra::crs(plots, proj = TRUE)

if (is.na(raster_crs) || !nzchar(raster_crs)) {
  stop("The RGB orthomosaic has no valid coordinate reference system.")
}

if (is.na(plot_crs) || !nzchar(plot_crs)) {
  stop("The plot boundary layer has no valid coordinate reference system.")
}

if (!terra::same.crs(vegetation_gli, plots)) {
  plots <- terra::project(
    plots,
    terra::crs(vegetation_gli)
  )
}
```

# 10. Overlay plot boundaries using standard R plots

There is no interactive map in this version.

```{r static-overlay, eval=FALSE}
plot(
  vegetation_gli,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"),
  main = "Vegetation GLI with Plot Boundaries"
)

plot(
  plots,
  add = TRUE,
  border = "black",
  lwd = 1.5
)
```

# 11. Extract plot-level crop traits

This chunk uses the existing `vegetation_gli`, `vegetation_mask`, and `plots` objects. It does not recalculate GLI or the segmentation mask.

```{r extract-traits, eval=FALSE}
mean_result <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_gli,
  plots,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

sd_result <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_gli,
  plots,
  fun = sd,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

cover_result <- terra::extract(
  vegetation_mask,
  plots,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)
```

# 12. Create the plot-level trait table

```{r trait-table, eval=FALSE}
plot_level_traits <- data.frame(
  plot_id = as.data.frame(plots)[[plot_id_field]],
  mean_vegetation_gli = round(mean_result[, 2], 4),
  sd_vegetation_gli = round(sd_result[, 2], 4),
  canopy_cover_percent = round(100 * cover_result[, 2], 2)
)

print(plot_level_traits)
```

# 13. Export results

```{r export-results, eval=FALSE}
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

output_file <- "outputs/plot_level_rgb_gli_traits.csv"

write.csv(
  plot_level_traits,
  output_file,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cat("Saved:", output_file, "\n")
```

# Workflow complete

The completed RStudio workflow creates:

```text
rgb
gli
otsu_threshold
vegetation_mask
vegetation_rgb
vegetation_gli
plots
plot_level_traits
```

If RStudio is restarted, use **Run All Chunks Above** from the chunk menu to rebuild the objects in sequence.
